baseline_policy: Keep B0 source frozen. Use the unified P1 contract from issue #5 as the shadow event stream and do not change its signal, stop, target or execution thresholds in this analysis.

stage_definitions.eligible_bar: A complete execution bar processed by the P1 reference after execution and higher-timeframe warmup, labeled LONG, SHORT or NEUTRAL by completed higher-timeframe bias.
stage_definitions.setup: A first eligible EMA20 touch that arms the P1 pullback state machine; expiry, invalidation, bias loss, trigger and end-of-data dispositions are retained.
stage_definitions.trigger: A completed P1 trigger event with immutable planned next-bar-open quote, stop and target.
stage_definitions.shadow_order_candidate: A trigger satisfying both the existing 2.5 ATR stop cap and cost/R <= 0.20 for the named sensitivity. This is a gate calculation, not an exchange order.
stage_definitions.assumed_quote_fill: A conditional path diagnostic assumes entry at the planned next-execution-bar open for barrier sequencing. It does not infer a limit fill or queue position.
stage_definitions.observed_orders_and_fills: Not available in the retained matched-window data; remain unknown and must not be represented as zero observed fills.

cost_sensitivities.classification: Predeclared non-funding cost scenarios. The 10 bp case references two standard regular-tier taker commissions; the 15/20 bp cases add assumed 5/10 bp of non-fee execution drag. They are not measured historical all-in costs or the user's account rate.

scenario_labels.10: Public regular-tier taker commission reference: 5 bp entry + 5 bp exit; excludes spread, slippage and funding.
scenario_labels.15: 10 bp commission reference + 5 bp assumed non-fee execution drag; hypothetical non-funding total-cost sensitivity.
scenario_labels.20: 10 bp commission reference + 10 bp assumed non-fee execution drag; hypothetical non-funding total-cost stress sensitivity.

public_fee_reference.product: Binance USDⓈ-M Futures, USDT maker/taker schedule
public_fee_reference.use_in_this_study: Reference only: the 10 bp case equals two taker-side commissions at the displayed regular-user rate. User-specific tier, discounts, promotions, historical fee changes and actual order types are unknown.

cost_sensitivities.net_pnl: Directional price PnL less scenario fraction times average entry/exit notional, divided by planned stop distance. Charge the scenario once; exclude funding and account-specific fills.

risk_gates.selection_policy: Do not relax gates or choose a new threshold from this inspected full-history diagnostic. Any later selected threshold/configuration must use the existing bounded experiment registry.

outcome_model.entry: Assumed fill at immutable planned next-bar-open quote; compare with the first aligned 1m candle open and retain its price difference.
outcome_model.primary_path: Trade 1m OHLC; mark 1m is a separate trigger-price sensitivity only.
outcome_model.barrier_order: Search forward from decision time. An adverse open beyond stop is GAP_STOP at the open; an open beyond target exits at the open as price improvement; a 1m candle touching both barriers remains AMBIGUOUS and uses a separate conservative stop-first PnL bound.
outcome_model.data_end: No forced time exit. Positions still open at history end are CENSORED; report mark-to-market separately and exclude them from realized shadow net-R averages.
outcome_model.overlap: Every candidate is evaluated independently; no portfolio compounding, overlap suppression, position limit, liquidation or capital allocation is inferred.
outcome_model.excursion: MFE/MAE in R use the observed 1m range from assumed entry through first barrier candle or data end; excursions in an ambiguous candle do not resolve intraminute ordering.
outcome_model.holding_time: Report the lower and upper one-minute bounds for a barrier candle; same-minute exits are [0,1] minutes, not exact execution durations.

stratification.volatility: Profile-specific tertiles of eligible-bar ATR/close percent; thresholds frozen across UTC months.
stratification.eligible_hours: Eligible bar count times execution interval, grouped by the side of the current completed higher-timeframe bias; NEUTRAL is retained separately.

configuration_budget.note: The 10/15/20 bp values already exist in the approved cost record and are sensitivities, not signal-parameter selection.
